question: Who founded the Council of Fashion Designers of America (CFDA)?
answer: Eleanor Lambert founded the CFDA in 1962.
why: The CFDA became a major professional organization representing American fashion designers.

question: In what year was New York Fashion Week first held?
why: It was created during World War II when American fashion needed an alternative to Paris.
